mostWorthwhile.text: Checking the rebalanced hover was most worthwhile: the level showed how an ordinary counterweight solved the tilt, even with an invented lift tile.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial tether and mat preparations were sensible but straightforward, with only one combination offered at each step.

surprise.text: The dragon made the whale nose-heavy despite the earlier balancing work; adding attractions changed the load.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, although the single available combination at each step left little room for meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would be curious to see the fair fly with its attractions working, though I would hope for more decisions than this mostly linear test offered.
